This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 04.01.2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Müller
Industrietechnik GmbH, with its registered office at Berliner Allee 19, Köln ("Party A"), and Bayerische Werkzeuge GmbH & Co. KG, with
its registered office at Berliner Allee 19, Hamburg ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Switzerland.

Signatures

Party A    Müller Industrietechnik GmbH / Hans Schneider
Party B    Bayerische Werkzeuge GmbH & Co. KG / Jürgen Hoffmann
Date       04.01.2026
